algorithm.name: Quality Wins
algorithm.description: Ranks players by cumulative quality points earned from victories against opponents, using pre-match effective ratings (Rating - 0.5 * RD).
algorithm.limitations: Evaluates victory quality above baseline 1500 using pre-match Glicko-2 ratings.

parameters.formula: Cumulative QoW = Sum of max(0, (Opponent Effective Rating - 1500) / 100) ^ 2
parameters.effectiveRatingFormula: Opponent Rating - 0.5 * Opponent RD (using pre-match snapshots)
